personal.preferred_title: Senior Data Engineer | AWS, SQL, Python, Parquet & Production Data Systems

summary: Senior Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across AWS data platforms, SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, ETL/ELT pipelines, Apache Parquet, production data systems, data quality, documentation, mentoring, and technical standards. Strong background building scalable data workflows, optimizing SQL and reporting layers, troubleshooting production systems, documenting operational procedures, and delivering reliable analytics datasets for business and technical stakeholders. Best aligned to senior data engineering roles requiring AWS, SQL/T-SQL/Postgres-adjacent database depth, Python, Parquet, scalable system design, production support, documentation, mentoring, and cross-functional technical leadership; OpenSearch/Elasticsearch and C# are positioned as adjacent or secondary areas rather than overstated production ownership.

Troubleshot production data and reporting issues by tracing source feeds, transformation logic, SQL behavior, failed outputs, latency symptoms, and downstream reporting discrepancies.

Partnered with infrastructure, application, analytics, and business stakeholders to establish repeatable delivery practices, mentor teammates, and align technical solutions with business needs.
